overview.description: The Lazard International Dynamic Equity ETF (IDEQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed to invest in a diversified portfolio of international equities. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation through a stock-picking process, while balancing risk. IDEQ was launched on May 29, 2015 and is issued by Lazard.
